summary_en: This study tests IMLYGIC, given alone, as a possible treatment for cutaneous neurofibromas in adults with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1). IMLYGIC is injected directly into the tumors on Days 1 and 21 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 4 cycles (8 treatments in total). The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase 1 study with a safety run-in to assess feasibility and efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba IMLYGIC, administrado solo, como posible tratamiento de neurofibromas cutáneos en adultos con neurofibromatosis tipo 1 (NF1). IMLYGIC se inyecta directamente en los tumores los días 1 y 21 de cada ciclo de 28 días, durante hasta 4 ciclos (8 tratamientos en total). El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase 1 con una etapa inicial de seguridad para evaluar la factibilidad y la eficacia.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with NF1 diagnosis by NIH clinical criteria
At least 8 measurable cutaneous neurofibromas, with specific size and location rules
Karnofsky performance level of 80% or higher
Blood counts, liver, kidney and albumin values within stated limits
Willing and able to follow the protocol and sign written consent
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women who are not using approved birth control
Immunosuppression, including HIV, active hepatitis B or C, or steroids above 10 mg/day prednisone equivalent
Prior IMLYGIC or GM-CSF treatment, or MEK inhibitor use within 6 months
Open herpetic skin lesions or ongoing anti-herpetic treatment
QTc interval above 470 msec or other conditions the investigator judges unsafe
